signal: Wavetronix, the radar traffic detection leader, marked 25 years and is expanding its SmartSensor and Intersection systems lineup across new regions

email.body1:
Jan, Wavetronix hitting 25 years as the radar detection leader, with the SmartSensor and Intersection systems lines expanding, says the regional opportunity is wide open.

In a long-cycle hardware market, more agencies are worth pursuing than a regional team can work before budgets shift, and that is where deals stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Wavetronix off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jan, quick follow-up for Wavetronix.

With the product lineup expanding, regional targets usually climb faster than one team can cover, and agency cycles are long. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to hit the number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Wavetronix needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jan, last bit of proof for Wavetronix.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Wavetronix' reply rate likely compares to other transportation technology teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jan, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling regional pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and agency budget cycles are their own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a regional agency sales motion? I will tailor it to Wavetronix either way.
